candidates.change_summary: Return msg.sender instead of the stored owner address.
Return the zero address instead of the stored owner address.
Remove the require check so transferOwnership accepts the zero address, changing owner() observable results and reverting behavior.
Remove the _checkOwner() call so the onlyOwner modifier no longer restricts callers, allowing any address to change ownership.
Replace the ownership transfer target with the zero address so ownership is always renounced instead of assigned to newOwner.
Delete the assignment 'rewardDistributor = _distributor;' so the state variable never changes when setRewardDistributor is called.
Replace 'rewardDistributor = _distributor;' with 'rewardDistributor = msg.sender;' so the stored distributor becomes the caller instead of the argument.
Replace 'rewardDistributor = _distributor;' with 'rewardDistributor = address(0);' so the stored distributor is always reset to the zero address.
Remove the assignment `migrator = _migrator;` so setMigrator emits the event but never updates the migrator state variable.
Replace the assignment with `migrator = address(0);` so setMigrator always stores the zero address instead of the given address.
